canonical_statement: For a Markov process X with initial state x and infinitesimal generator A, an admissible function f, and an admissible stopping time tau, the expected stopped value satisfies E_x[f(X_tau)] = f(x) + E_x[integral from 0 to tau of (A f)(X_s) ds].
domain_and_universes: Provisional: a measurable state space, a time-homogeneous Markov process on it, real-valued generator-domain functions, and a probability space; exact Lean universes and object model remain open.
quantifiers: state space E and initial state x : E
Markov process X indexed by nonnegative time with generator A
f in the domain of A
stopping time tau satisfying the selected integrability/boundedness conditions
hypotheses: X has the Markov and regularity assumptions needed to define A
f belongs to the generator domain
f(X_tau) and the stopped generator integral are integrable
tau satisfies the source theorem's boundedness or localization conditions

alternate_encodings.target: martingale statement f(X_t) - f(X_0) - integral_0^t A f(X_s) ds

excluded_degenerate_cases: The discrete-time identity and deterministic-time semigroup identity are not substitutes for the stopped continuous-time formula. tau = 0 is a boundary probe only.
